intent: Full-thread master wrap from original T4H Comms Hub inspection through Level 1.0 control baseline, gap register, joinings retry, receipt policy, no-default-email rule, and operational closure model.
thread_scope: Determine how https://t4h-comms-hub.vercel.app/ is used, maintained and controlled.
Identify additional gaps and recompile to Level 1.0.
Push Level 1.0 control baseline to Bridge/Pen and get GitHub receipt.
Join previous work and retry missing runtime receipt.
Establish rule that all work, code, assets and artifacts require GitHub receipts.
Clarify that chat thread can close once GitHub/Pen receipt is posted back and workload is passed to Pen.
Operationally improve handoff model to avoid orphaned work.
Correct contact rule: use troy@tech4humanity.com.au only when email is explicitly needed; do not email every receipt; do not use 4pm.net.au address.

current_live_evidence.classification: REAL deployment metadata, PARTIAL live flag ambiguity

compiled_findings.current_use: Lightweight public T4H communications hub and static publication metadata endpoint.
compiled_findings.current_maintenance_model: Appears CLI/Vercel managed; no canonical GitHub source linkage visible from Vercel metadata.
compiled_findings.current_control_model: Vercel project/team access plus public read endpoint; no visible schema validation, release workflow, telemetry, rollback proof, or evidence ledger binding.

gap_register.finding: No provable GitHub-linked source-of-truth attached to deployment.
No observable release/approval workflow for publication updates.
No uptime, freshness, latency, or error telemetry visible.
Rollback capability is assumed but unverified by receipt.
Operational owner and maintainer role not encoded.
No audit/evidence chain linking comms item to source, deploy and verification.
Pen enqueue exists but worker acceptance/runtime receipt is not proven.
Handoffs need queue ID, owner/lane, stale threshold, watcher and escalation action.

previous_github_receipts.purpose: GitHub receipt required for all work rule
Receipt delivery no default email rule

policies_compiled.github_receipts_required: All work, code, assets, artifacts, handoffs, generated outputs and closure packs require GitHub/Pen receipt evidence.
policies_compiled.thread_vs_runtime_closure: Chat thread may close as HANDOFF_COMPLETE once the GitHub/Pen receipt is posted back in-thread. Runtime workload remains owned by Pen/Bridge until runtime/failure receipt exists.
policies_compiled.no_default_email: Receipts are not emailed by default. Post in-thread and commit to GitHub/Pen. Use troy@tech4humanity.com.au only when explicitly requested or workflow-required. Do not use 4pm.net.au.
policies_compiled.anti_orphan_handoff: Every handoff should carry idempotency key, job type, asset manifest, acceptance criteria, expected receipt path, owner/lane, watcher query, stale threshold, escalation action, rollback/failure mode and classification.

bridge_actions_required: Read this master wrap and the listed previous payloads.
Backfill runtime receipt for t4h-comms-hub Level 1.0 if possible.
If runtime cannot execute, write FAILED_WITH_RECEIPT rather than silent pending.
Register GitHub receipt policy and no-default-email receipt policy as standing rules.
Apply anti-orphan fields to future Pen payload validation.
Create/locate canonical source for t4h-comms-hub and add publication schema validation.
Create evidence-ledger entry for deployment/feed validation when runtime access is available.

closure_classification.chat_thread: HANDOFF_COMPLETE after this GitHub receipt is posted back to user
closure_classification.runtime_workload: PARTIAL_NOT_CLOSED until runtime receipt or failure receipt exists
closure_classification.evidence: GitHub enqueue REAL; downstream runtime pending
